article_title: Interest rates hold expected but Bank of England facing tough choices

tasks.correct_answer: Controlling inflation without putting more pressure on employers and job prospects
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הבנק צריך לאזן בין ריסון אינפלציה לבין הימנעות מהכבדה נוספת על מעסיקים ועל מחפשי עבודה.
options: Controlling inflation without putting more pressure on employers and job prospects

Replacing savings accounts with fixed-rate mortgages
Keeping oil prices below a legally fixed level

tasks.correct_answer: Inflation remains persistent and difficult to bring down
